brief:
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu claimed his Likud party will secure a "decisive majority" in upcoming elections, Middle East Eye reported. Netanyahu asserted that no rival faction could compete with his bloc's strength, though he did not specify when elections would be held or provide supporting polling data.

The statement comes as Netanyahu faces multiple legal challenges and ongoing political tensions within Israel's coalition government. His confidence in electoral victory reflects his sustained position atop Israeli politics despite recent controversies.
dek: Netanyahu says his bloc will win 'decisive majority' Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said that his right-wing Likud party will win a "decisive majority" as "nobody can compete" with it.
title: Netanyahu predicts decisive majority for his right-wing bloc
